{"consolidated_memory":"INTERMITTENT EOF IN CRYPTO/TLS/HANDSHAKE.GO - THREE SEPARATE INCIDENTS

All three incidents involve the same file (crypto/tls/handshake.go) on the security side, sharing the same signal (unexpected end of stream during negotiation) and reproduction method (open many short lived connections in a row). Each had a different root cause and fix.

---

INCIDENT 1: [2026-01-11]
Environment: Staging read replica only
Root Cause: Floating point rounding in the money path
Fix: Moved arithmetic to integer minor units (PR #1132, branch fix/intermittent-eof-1)
Result: Error rate dropped from 1.0 percent to under 1 per ten thousand
Note: Same corner of code as earlier intermittent EOF work with context carried over

---

INCIDENT 2: [2026-01-15]
Environment: Only for tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
Root Cause: Serialiser dropping fields it did not know
Fix: Switched to strict schema that rejects unknown fields (PR #5076, branch fix/intermittent-eof-2)
Result: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 62 days running
Note: Same corner of code as earlier intermittent EOF work with context carried over

---

INCIDENT 3: [2026-02-01]
Environment: Only for users sitting in a negative UTC offset
Root Cause: Error swallowed by a bare except handler
Fix: Narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate (PR #9101, branch fix/intermittent-eof-3)
Stack: Go; covering check in crypto/tls/handshake_test.go
Result: Memory settled at 845 MB instead of climbing past 7 GB"}
